title: Great for tile / wood floors, attachment tools could be better...
text:
Great for tile / wood floors, attachment tools could be better.... I needed something to vacuum up my tiled kitchen floor and linoleum bathroom floor, and the Electrolux Ergorapido fits the bill nicely. Setup was a breeze; the unit should be charged up to 24 hours before use. This 2-in-1 stick vac consists of a canister vac that snaps into the stick vac (the canister vac contains the filter). The storage base also holds a crevice tool and "dusting brush" (more on that in a moment). The Brushrollclean Technology allows the brush to self-clean, which is a great feature.

There are numerous features about the Electrolux that I really liked; the swivel head is great at reaching under the fridge and oven or along baseboards. I also liked that there are lights along the leading edge, so you can see if you've gotten everything. One off-putting thing was that upon the first several uses, both the canister vac and stic vac smelled strongly of Band-aids (must be from the plastic or components). I was also not crazy about the cheap feel of the charging cable cord, which seems brittle and lightweight. The charging stand and footprint are fairly small (you can also wall-mount the stand).

After using the stick vac in the kitchen and bathroom, next I tried using the canister vac in the car, and here is where I ran into problems with the attachment. I had an old Black and Decker canister vac that I used to use, and it had a brush that snapped directly onto the vacuum nozzle. The Electrolux requires that you first snap on the crevice tool (which is a good 8"-9") and then the brush; there is no way to attach the brush directly. Also, the dusting brush's bristles are MUCH softer than my old vac, so the bristles bent easily (I was using it to clean the leather seats). However, it did a good job at cleaning floormats and leather seats, so I'm happy. The reservoir holds a LOT, and the Electrolux definitely did a much better job at picking up dirt / debris than my old vacuum.

Overall there are many pluses for the Electorlux EL2021A; I loved the swivel head, the lights, the fact it is easy to store and maneuver (I can't comment on battery life as I've only used the vacuum for short runs so far). The two-year warranty was also a plus. My only critique is that I wished different tools were included, but otherwise it does a great job on tile / wood floors and as a hand vac.

description: The Ergorapido Plus Brushroll Clean 2-in-1 cordless stick and handheld vacuum gives you cordless freedom with extra cleaning power on bare floors and an exclusive innovative feature, Brushroll Clean Technology. Brushroll Clean Technology removes tangled hair from your vacuum's brushroll for you with the simple touch of a button. The Ergorapido Plus Brushroll Clean offers two vacuums in one stylish design for cleaning on and above your bare floors. The variable speed and 12V NiMH battery give you an extended run time to clean all the bare floors of your home. 180-degree swivel-head helps you twist and turn around furniture with ease. Plus the lightweight, bagless design makes it easy for you to get aroundâ€"get up and down stairs and carry from room to room. The crevice tool and dusting brush store conveniently in the charging stand.
